horizon_note: From the doors Matt walks through (2.1 m rule): pawnshop door 0.48, apartment door 0.457, tea-house double doors 0.45-0.49. At 0.48 Matt is 88% of the pawnshop door, as in the office.

apartment-door.note: the tenement's street door and hallway: stairs up to the first-floor corridor

pawnshop-door.note: the pawnshop's door (behind the lamp post) and window

far-end.note: the back of the street: the city map

passage.note: the narrow passage beside the pawnshop, through to the alley behind it

lights.name: lamp
lights.note: The street lamp is lit even by day; weak, short shadows.

lights.name: sky
lights.note: Overcast winter sky down the street; soft shadows toward the camera.

props.name: newsboy
props.note: Background newspaper boy calling the headline from the recessed shop doorway past the open apartment door (where the junkie stood), the bin in front of him; 1.50 m at the same depth. Enlarged 12% on review.

anim.note: Ludo griffin-hd idle loop, 36 frames, start and end on the static pose.

props.name: apartment-door-leaf
props.note: The open apartment door's leaf, cut from the painting along its edge, drawn over the newspaper boy's raised hand (he stands behind it). Part of the painting: no shadow, no footprint.
